priorityList: Use Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting.
Cast Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is ready (or in less than 1 second) and you have enough resources.
Cast Pillar of Frost if Reaper's Mark is already on cooldown or its remaining cooldown is greater than 10 seconds.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa if Pillar of Frost is active or the fight is ending.
Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown, especially if Gathering Storm is talented.
Cast Obliterate if Killing Machine has 2 stacks, or if it has 1 stack and you have 3 or more Runes.
Cast Howling Blast if Rime is active.
Cast Frost Strike if the target has 5 stacks of Razorice (with Shattering Blade talented).
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury near the end of Pillar of Frost, but only if Reaper's Mark is NOT on the target and Exterminate is NOT active.
Cast Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes and low Runic Power.
Cast Frost Strike if you are close to capping Runic Power (deficit < 30).
Cast Obliterate if Killing Machine is active.
Cast Frost Strike to spend Runic Power and prevent overcapping.
Cast Obliterate as your primary Rune spender and filler.
